column1: # NDMW.AFS entry 621 (stag0102's model pack) -- every geometry attribute the offline chain
# `igVertexArray1_1`, whose `_vdata` block lists this array's streams and whose `_numVerts` is
# the count; a stream block's `_memSize` is its content size exactly (12*_numVerts positions,
# 8*_numVerts UVs) and the pool is laid out 4-byte aligned, so the stream starts at the block's
# own offset.  `_stripLengths` gives the primitive lengths, validated by sum == _numVerts.
# columns: vertexArray  primType  numPrims  numVerts  vdata  numLengths  stream ids  name
# scripts/verify_models_layout.py re-derives every row from the pack; the extraction is
# compared against the live game's models by ../testing/verify_models_offline.py and against
# the port's C reader by port/tools/verify_models.py.
# The name comes from the shape -> attribute link (an igGeometry's ordinal-2 DCC name and its
# ordinal-8 igAttrList, whose array block holds that shape's attribute ids), found by ordinal
# because a record's byte offsets shift with the length of its name string.
